recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless future terminology packaging changes break the ValueSet's THO CodeSystem reference.
issue_request: FHIR-16733 is a Published/Persuasive STU3 core Observation issue asking to change the Observation Reference Range Meaning code midcycle definition from an expected range during the follicular stage of the cycle to an expected range during the midcycle stage.
initial_application: The request was applied in git commit 69761b715e5c64e5f02da9d3cab64b40f1b00d1b, which changed source/observation/codesystem-referencerange-meaning.xml from follicular stage to midcycle stage for the midcycle concept.
additional_context: Commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 later removed the local core CodeSystem source as part of moving UTG terminology content out of the core build. Current core source keeps Observation active and the Observation Reference Range Meaning ValueSet composes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/referencerange-meaning. The current THO JSON for that CodeSystem already contains the corrected midcycle definition. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR core checkout no longer owns the CodeSystem definition that FHIR-16733 originally changed, and the external terminology source referenced by core already contains the requested wording.
